GameplayEvent Rules9 sections
Event Rules

◆ During the Time to Eat! Delicious Dungeon Quest, you can increase your fellows' exploration power, challenge stages and earn rich rewards.

◆ Open equipment box to obtain higher-level and higher-quality gear, and challenge more stages!

Exploration Power

◆ In the Time to Eat! Delicious Dungeon Quest, you need to increase exploration power, which is independent of fellow power outside the event.

◆ Exploration Power = Basic Stats Power + Substat Power

◆ Basic Stats Power, Substat Power can be increased by equipping gear, upgrading the stoneblade, purchasing stoneblade power bundles, or purchasing pass.

◆ Fellow/Family Power Bonus: they can be increased by obtaining corresponding fellows or family, increasing their rarity, and increasing their stella level.

Equipment

◆ Equipment slots: earrings, shield, helmet, shoulders, bracers, chest armor, necklace, gloves, belt, ring, leg armor, boots.

◆ Equipment rarity (low to high): green, blue, purple, orange, red.

◆ Only one gear can be equipped in each slot at a time. When you obtain another piece for the same slot, you must choose one to dismantle.

◆ Dismantled gear cannot be recovered. Dismantling grants Box EXP and stoneblade EXP. Higher-level gear gives more EXP.

Equipment Attribute

◆ Equipment attribute are divided into basic stats and substat.

◆ Basic Stats: ATK, DEF, HP, SPD. Each gear has all four stats. ATK: Determines damage dealt. DEF: Reduces damage taken. HP: Determines health; reaching 0 results in defeat. SPD: Determines turn order.

◆ Total Basic Stats = (Stoneblade Attribute + Equipment Attribute + Stoneblade Bundle bonus + Pass Privilege Stats) * (1+ Fellow/Family Bonus)

◆ Substats: CRIT, CRIT DMG, BLK, Lifesteal, EVA, Stun, Counter, DMG Increase, DMG Reduction.

◆ Substats can be viewed in gear details.

◆ Total Substats = Equipment Attribute only. There's no other method to increase substats value.

Equipment Box

◆ Open equipment box to obtain random gear of different slots, levels, and rarities.

◆ Dismantle gear to gain Box EXP, which can be used to upgrade equipment box.

◆ The higher the box's level, the greater the chance of obtaining high-rarity gear.

Stoneblade

◆ Dismantle gear to gain Stoneblade EXP, which can be used to upgrade stoneblade.

◆ Leveling up the stoneblade increases base status, grants rewards, and raises both the minimum and maximum level of randomly obtained gear.

Combat

◆ Battles are turn-based. Both sides attack in order of SPD, with each side attacking once per turn. If SPD is the same, your side attacks first.

◆ Battles last up to 10 turns. HP reaching 0 results in defeat. If both sides survive all turns, the side with higher remaining HP wins. In the event of a tie, your side loses.

◆ Damage = (Basic Attack value * Substats Bonus * DMG Increase Bonus) * Power Suppression Coefficient

Camp

◆ Up to 6 resource queues can be unlocked in camp. Each queue generates 1 type of resource, and the 6th queue grants double collection rewards.

◆ Resources are divided into 3 types: food, equipment box, and random. Successfully collecting them grants a certain amount of food, equipment boxes, or either of the two at random.

◆ The camp's level increases based on the number of times resources are collected. The higher the camp's level, the higher the level of refreshed resources.

◆ Resource level affects collection time, deployable employees and collection rewards.

◆ There're two types of resource refresh: Auto Refresh and Manual Refresh. Auto Refresh: Refresh countdown begins after all queued resources are successfully collected (up to 30 times daily). Manual Refresh: Spend crystals to refresh. No daily limit.

◆ Assign employees to collect resources. More employees can speed up the collection progress.

◆ Employees lose energy after collection. When energy reaches 0, they can still continue collecting but collection time is greatly increased.

◆ Spend food to recruit employees. You can gain extra employees after unlocking the 6th queue.

◆ Auto-collection allows you to configure employee assignment, and it remains effective even while you're offline.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ The event features both an overall and a daily leaderboard.

◆ The daily leaderboard resets daily, with rankings determined separately by the number of equipment boxes opened personally and the total number opened by all guild members.

◆ The overall leaderboard is settled at the end of the event. Rankings are determined separately by personal exploration power and the total exploration power of the guild.

◆ When leaderboard results are finalized, rewards can be claimed based on your ranking position.

◆ Any unclaimed rewards will be delivered via in‑game mail.
